dialogues.speaker: Farbal
dialogues.text: I wish the older students would stop coming over to ask. This really, truly is just a toy.

dialogues.speaker: Farbal
dialogues.text: Ah? Oh... It's you, Traveler. Would you like to play a round or two of "Gathering of Stars"?

choices.text: I'd like to give this a try.

response.speaker: Farbal
response.text: Sure. The astrolabe is over here.

choices.text: I've got other things to do right now, sorry.

response.speaker: Farbal
response.text: Well, I'll be here at the booth throughout the Gala. If you're of a mind to play, just hit me up.
